rows.name: Adaptive Fortune
rows.description: Your luck takes on almost legendary proportions.

rows.name: Agile Tongue
rows.description: Your long pink tongue is capable of manipulating small items and even stealing objects.

rows.name: Airy Step
rows.description: The air responds to your innate elemental nature, protecting you from harm and cushioning your falls.

rows.name: Angel Wings
rows.description: Feathered wings sprout from your back.

rows.name: Angelic Blood
rows.description: Your blood is infused with holy power.

rows.name: Angelic Flesh
rows.description: Your skin shines like burnished metal.

rows.name: Aquatic Ancestry
rows.description: You favor your outsider ancestry and are better adapted to life in the water.

rows.name: Armor of the Pit
rows.description: Your fiendish traits take the form of a protective scaly skin.

rows.name: Attuned to the Wild
rows.description: You share a strong mystic connection with one type of wilderness terrain.

rows.name: Beast Rider
rows.description: You gain the service of a monstrous companion or mount.

rows.name: Bestow Luck
rows.description: You are extremely lucky and sometimes your allies are as well.

rows.name: Black Cat
rows.description: Bad luck befalls those who dare to cross you.

rows.name: Blood Drinker
rows.description: Consuming blood reinvigorates you.

rows.name: Blood Feaster
rows.description: Consuming blood gives you superhuman strength.

rows.name: Blood Salvage
rows.description: You do not need to drink blood from a living creature to gain healing benefits.

rows.name: Blood Vengeance
rows.description: Seeing an ally fall in combat fills you with a raging and murderous fury.

rows.name: Born Alone
rows.description: You are so tough and vicious that you killed and ate the rest of your litter while still in the womb.

rows.name: Brewmaster
rows.description: You can concoct potent brews.

rows.name: Burn! Burn! Burn!
rows.description: You take the goblin love of arson and fire play to a whole new level.

rows.name: Burrowing Teeth
rows.description: You have teeth and claws that suit you well to digging.

rows.name: Carrion Feeder
rows.description: Like many scavengers, you can stomach foods that would make weaker creatures ill.

rows.name: Casual Illusionist
rows.description: You can use your innate magic to create minor illusions that augment your efforts at trickery and deceit.

rows.name: Catfolk Exemplar
rows.description: Your feline traits are more defined and prominent than those of other members of your race.

rows.name: Celestial Servant
rows.description: Rather than being a normal animal or beast, your companion or familiar hails from the heavenly realms.

rows.name: Channel Force
rows.description: Your channel is bolstered by your faith, allowing you to move and damage your foes.

rows.name: Cloud Gazer
rows.description: Your insight into your elemental heritage gives you a clarity of sight few humans possess.

rows.name: Courageous Resolve
rows.description: Even when others run, you tend to stand your ground.

rows.name: Dark Sight
rows.description: With further modification, your eyes can pierce the gloom of even magical darkness.

rows.name: Dauntless Destiny
rows.description: Your ability to avert disaster is impressive.

rows.name: Deafening Explosion
rows.description: Your bombs explode with deafening force.

rows.name: Defiant Luck
rows.description: You can sometimes defiantly shrug off spells and attacks that would kill a lesser creature.

rows.name: Discerning Eye
rows.description: You are not easily fooled by illusions and forgeries.

rows.name: Diverse Palate
rows.description: Your taste for blood is broader than that of other dhampirs.

rows.name: Draconic Aspect
rows.description: You possess some of the qualities of your dragon ancestors.

rows.name: Draconic Breath
rows.description: You possess draconic defenses and a draconic breath weapon.

rows.name: Draconic Glide
rows.description: You possess draconic defenses and wings that allow you to glide.

rows.name: Draconic Paragon
rows.description: You can shrug off sleep and paralysis effects as well as any dragon, and your draconic aspects improve.

rows.name: Drow Nobility
rows.description: Your blood courses with power, granting you greater spell-like abilities.

rows.name: Spider Step
rows.description: You tread where only arachnids dare.

rows.name: Dwarf Blooded
rows.description: You have dwarven blood coursing through your veins.

rows.name: Echoes of Stone
rows.description: Your senses are keener among the rocks and stones.

qualifiers: Survival=Avoid Becoming Lost in Caverns and Rocky Areas

rows.name: Elemental Jaunt
rows.description: The spirits of your ancestral home call to you, beckoning you to return.

rows.name: Elven Spirit
rows.description: Although you are of mixed heritage, you are closer to your elven relatives and the magic in their blood flows freely in your veins.

rows.name: Exile's Path
rows.description: A lifetime spent shunned by others and eschewing your heritage makes you resistant to efforts to pry inside of your mind.

rows.name: Expanded Fiendish Resistance (Acid)
rows.description: You gain extra fiendish resistances.

rows.name: Expanded Fiendish Resistance (Cold)
rows.description: You gain extra fiendish resistances.

rows.name: Expanded Fiendish Resistance (Electricity)
rows.description: You gain extra fiendish resistances.

rows.name: Expanded Fiendish Resistance (Fire)
rows.description: You gain extra fiendish resistances.

rows.name: Expanded Resistance
rows.description: You have expanded your natural resistance to magic to encompass different kinds of magic.

rows.name: Extra Elemental Assault
rows.description: You have unlocked greater elemental power.

rows.name: Fast Learner
rows.description: Your progress gains extra versatility.

rows.name: Fearless Curiosity
rows.description: Your desire to see and experience the world overrides healthy caution.

rows.name: Feline Grace
rows.description: Your innate grace allows you to get out of the stickiest situations.

rows.name: Ferocious Action
rows.description: You ferocity is quick but shorter lived.

rows.name: Ferocious Resolve
rows.description: Your orc heritage allows you to fight on.

rows.name: Ferocious Summons
rows.description: Your summoned creatures gain your ferocity.

rows.name: Fiend Sight
rows.description: Your eyes develop keener sight in dim light and darkness.

rows.name: Fire Tamer
rows.description: You know your way around even magical fire.

rows.name: Firesight
rows.description: Fire no longer blinds you, and smoke conceals nothing from your gaze.

rows.name: Flame Heart
rows.description: You have mastered fire magic and alchemy.

rows.name: Foment the Blood
rows.description: You can unleash a wave of energy that drives orcs into a frenzy.

rows.name: Fortunate One
rows.description: You have an even greater knack than most halflings for adaptable luck.

rows.name: Giant Steps
rows.description: When enlarged, your speed increases.

rows.name: Gloom Sight
rows.description: With a combination of strange shadow magic and chirurgery, your eyes are permanently modified to see farther in darkness.

rows.name: Gore Fiend
rows.description: Horrible wounds, whether on yourself or your enemies, make your blood sing.

rows.name: Grasping Tail
rows.description: Your tail becomes more useful.

rows.name: Greater Channel Force
rows.description: Your eruptions of divine power move your enemies.

rows.name: Greater Drow Nobility
rows.description: You have mastered the lesser spell-like abilities of the drow, demonstrating true nobility.

rows.name: Guardian of the Wild
rows.description: Your mystic connection with the wilderness enhances your ability to react to threats.

rows.name: Half-Drow Paragon
rows.description: Your drow blood is particularly strong.

rows.name: Heavenly Radiance
rows.description: Your heavenly light can be used in a variety of ways.

rows.name: Heroic Will
rows.description: Your indomitable will breaks free from mental shackles.

rows.name: Hobgoblin Discipline
rows.description: The presence of other hobgoblins bolsters your resolve.

rows.name: Human Spirit
rows.description: Your blood burns with the passion and unyielding quest for self-improvement displayed so prominently by your human relatives.

rows.name: Huntmaster
rows.description: You are an expert trainer of horses, hounds, falcons, or hunting cats.

rows.name: Hydraulic Maneuver
rows.description: You can use your hydraulic push to disarm or trip.

rows.name: Improved Channel Force
rows.description: You move your enemies within a beam of righteous energy.

rows.name: Improved Dark Sight
rows.description: With further modification, your eyes see clearly in not only normal darkness, but in magical darkness as well.

rows.name: Improved Drow Nobility
rows.description: Your magical heritage is more potent than that of your peers, as demonstrated by your superior spell-like abilities.

rows.name: Improved Improvisation
rows.description: You are masterful in your improvisation.

rows.name: Improved Umbral Scion
rows.description: You are a master of drow noble magic.

rows.name: Improvisation
rows.description: You can figure out how to do almost anything.

rows.name: Incremental Elemental Assault
rows.description: You may activate and quench your elemental assault ability multiple times per day.

rows.name: Inexplicable Luck
rows.description: Others are often dumfounded by your luck.

rows.name: Inner Breath
rows.description: Your body is suffused with elemental air that provides for all your respiratory needs.

rows.name: Intimidating Confidence
rows.description: You have boundless faith in your success.

rows.name: Ledge Walker
rows.description: You negotiate tiny ledges like a mountain goat.

rows.name: Life's Blood
rows.description: Your blood flows with eternal life, and its healing powers allow you use your blood to heal others.

rows.name: Lingering Invisibility
rows.description: You remain briefly translucent after losing invisibility.

rows.name: Long-Nose Form
rows.description: You can shift into the form of a human with an unusually long nose.

rows.name: Lucky Healer
rows.description: Your luck allows you to draw from magical healing far more efficiently than most.

rows.name: Mage of the Wild
rows.description: Your mystic connection with the wilderness enhances your spellcasting.

rows.name: Magical Tail
rows.description: You grow an extra tail that represents your growing magical powers.

rows.name: Metallic Wings
rows.description: Your wing feathers are made of gleaming metal.

rows.name: Mother's Gift
rows.description: You inherit a special boon from your hag parent.

rows.name: Multitalented Mastery
rows.description: You are adept at numerous disciplines.

rows.name: Murmurs of Earth
rows.description: The earth opens up her secrets to your perceptions.

rows.name: Natural Charmer
rows.description: You possess some of the dominating powers of your vampire progenitor.

rows.name: Neither Elf nor Human
rows.description: You have removed yourself from your heritage so thoroughly that even magic does not recognize you.

rows.name: Noble Spell Resistance
rows.description: Your ascension is complete; you have the spell resistance approaching that of a demon.

rows.name: Oread Burrower
rows.description: The ground parts for you at the slightest touch, allowing you to dig with great speed.

rows.name: Oread Earth Glider
rows.description: The earth welcomes you, showing you the secret paths through sand and soil.

rows.name: Realistic Likeness
rows.description: When you are in human form, you can take the shape of a specific individual.

rows.name: Resilient Brute
rows.description: You absorb punishment others find deadly.

rows.name: Resolute Rager
rows.description: Fear passes quickly while you are raging.

rows.name: Scavenger's Eye
rows.description: Your gaze is naturally drawn to valuable glittering objects.

rows.name: Seen and Unseen
rows.description: Your anonymity makes you difficult to find through magical or mundane means, and you have learned how to combat both of your progenitor races.

rows.name: Shadow Caster
rows.description: Your command over shadow and darkness create longer-lasting spell effects.

rows.name: Shadow Ghost
rows.description: You can move between the Shadow Plane and the Material Plane more often.

rows.name: Shadow Walker
rows.description: You can pierce the veil between the Shadow Plane and the Material Plane more often, and to greater effect.

rows.name: Shadowy Dash
rows.description: In dim light, you resemble little more than a shadow.

rows.name: Shared Manipulation
rows.description: You can subtly bolster allies' ability to misdirect and infuriate their enemies.

rows.name: Sleep Venom
rows.description: You can change the nature of your toxic spittle to put your enemies to sleep.

rows.name: Spider Summoner
rows.description: You gain the ability to summon powerful spiders.

rows.name: Spirit of the Wild
rows.description: Your mystic connection with one type of wilderness has grown even stronger.

rows.name: Steam Caster
rows.description: You imbue your fire spells with elemental water, transforming them into powerful gouts of steam.

rows.name: Stoic Pose
rows.description: You can hold yourself as still as a statue, evading detection.

rows.name: Stony Step
rows.description: The earth recognizes its kinship with you and does not impede your movement.

rows.name: Stretched Wings
rows.description: You strengthen your crippled wings.

rows.name: Sure and Fleet
rows.description: You are both fast and careful.

rows.name: Surge of Success
rows.description: Your success drives your further actions.

rows.name: Tenacious Survivor
rows.description: Your spirit lingers long after any other's would have passed on.

rows.name: Tengu Raven Form
rows.description: You can shift into the form of a giant black raven.

rows.name: Tengu Wings
rows.description: You can grow wings that allow you to fly.

rows.name: Thrill of the Kill
rows.description: Killing fuels your rage.

rows.name: Toxic Recovery
rows.description: Your system recuperates from the effects of poisons with astonishing speed.

rows.name: Trap Wrecker
rows.description: You can smash traps instead of disarming them.

rows.name: Triton Portal
rows.description: You can channel your inner magic to summon allies.

rows.name: Tunnel Rat
rows.description: You are a master of fighting in confined spaces.

rows.name: Umbral Scion
rows.description: New spell-like abilities are unlocked for you as you rise to ascendency among the drow people.

rows.name: Water Skinned
rows.description: Your touch extinguishes small flames.

rows.name: Wings of Air
rows.description: The winds lift you, carrying you where you want to go.
